reader.requirement: END-UNSTRING must close the UNSTRING statement it pairs with, whatever conditional phrases (none, ON OVERFLOW, NOT ON OVERFLOW, both) it carries, so statements after it belong to the enclosing scope, a nested UNSTRING inside an overflow phrase is closed by its own END-UNSTRING, and an END-UNSTRING with no open UNSTRING is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: conditional-phrases-any-order-2002: ON OVERFLOW written after NOT ON OVERFLOW is refused at 85 (COBOL0900); not the scope terminator

reader.edition-search: grep of the unstringStatement / conditionalPhrases grammar and StringEmitter.EmitUnstring for Edition|Dialect|ConstructRegistry: END_UNSTRING is parsed and scoped by the grammar with no edition switch
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c35_unstring_receiving_operands covers END-UNSTRING on a plain statement; nesting inside an overflow phrase, use inside IF and PERFORM, and the orphan END-UNSTRING are not exercised

probes.printed: S1 OVF / S1 AFTER IN IF; S2 NOOVF / S2 INNER OVF / S2 STILL IN NOT ON / S2 AFTER OUTER; S3 OVF P0 / S3 AFTER; S4 AAABBBCCC; S5 OVF / S5 AAA (inside an inline PERFORM)
probes.expected: each END-UNSTRING closes only its own UNSTRING; the statements after it run in the enclosing IF or PERFORM

probes.printed: COBOL0306: END-UNSTRING appears without a matching UNSTRING statement
COBOL0900: ON OVERFLOW after NOT ON OVERFLOW requires COBOL-2002 (§1985:IV.2.1)
probes.expected: refused at 85: the 1985 format prints ON OVERFLOW first

probes.printed: OV / AFTER INNER STILL IN OUTER OV (an inner UNSTRING in the outer ON OVERFLOW closed by the one END-UNSTRING)
probes.expected: END-UNSTRING pairs with the innermost UNSTRING; the DISPLAY stays in the outer ON OVERFLOW phrase

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR19  the text is in the clause or rule: "The END-UNSTRING phrase delimits the scope of the UNSTRING statement"

reader.notes: The grammar makes END_UNSTRING the optional last element of unstringStatement after conditionalPhrases, so the parser pairs it with the innermost open UNSTRING; the probes confirm nesting in IF, PERFORM and an overflow phrase.

refuter.evidence: Probe probes-refute-c07/src/ru1.cob at --std 85 (runs/ru1-002, EXIT 0): UNSTRING ... END-UNSTRING used as the imperative of ADD ON SIZE ERROR, followed by a DISPLAY still in that phrase (U1 IN SIZE ERROR AAA); an UNSTRING with ON OVERFLOW and no END-UNSTRING inside IF ... ELSE, closed by ELSE (U2 OVF / U2 AFTER); an inner UNSTRING ... END-UNSTRING in an outer ON OVERFLOW followed by a statement in that phrase, with the outer NOT ON OVERFLOW after it (U3 STILL IN OUTER). The reversed phrase order is refused COBOL0900 at 85 (ru1-001). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR19 ... The END-UNSTRING phrase delimits the scope of the UNSTRING statement.'
